title: How Does SAM-3 Adapt? Capacity, Update Geometry, and Domain Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2611.27142v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Promptable segmentation foundation models are increasingly used in specialized domains, but it remains unclear how SAM-3 should be fine-tuned when adapting it beyond its original training distribution. We study this question by comparing five adaptation families --LoRA, HiRA, KRAdapter, QuanTA, and Full Fine-Tuning-- across five segmentation datasets spanning medical imaging, remote sensing, and dense material segmentation. Across these datasets, compact parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods often match or approach Full Fine-Tuning in DSC and IoU, suggesting that strong in-domain adaptation does not always require updating the full model. However, this performance cannot be explained by nominal adapter rank or trainable parameter count alone. translated_title: SAM-3 如何适应？容量、更新几何与领域迁移
translated_abstract: 提示式分割基础模型正日益被应用于专业领域，但在将 SAM-3 适应到其原始训练分布之外时，应如何进行微调仍不清楚。我们通过比较五种适应方法家族——LoRA、HiRA、KRAdapter、QuanTA 和全量微调——在五个跨越医学影像、遥感和密集材料分割的分割数据集上研究这一问题。在这些数据集上，紧凑的参数高效微调方法在 DSC 和 IoU 指标上往往能匹配或接近全量微调，这表明强大的领域内适应并不总是需要更新整个模型。然而，这种性能无法仅凭名义上的适配器秩或可训练参数数量来解释。为了探究为什么不同方法表现相似，我们分析了它们的更新谱及其在 LoveDA Urban/Rural 迁移下的行为。我们的 SVD 分析表明，全量微调的更新……
tldr: 本研究系统比较了五种微调方法在五个分割领域的表现，发现参数高效微调可媲美全量微调，且其性能由更新谱几何特性而非参数数量或秩决定。
en_tdlr: This study compares five adaptation methods across five segmentation domains, showing that parameter-efficient fine-tuning can match full fine-tuning, with performance governed by update spectral geometry rather than parameter count or nominal rank.
